summary: Seed a remounted journal from this session's stored cursor, and refuse a cursor written by a previous process

coordination.notes: The persistence lives in aiEventJournal.ts rather than in the host, because that module already owns cursors and putting the record anywhere else would mean two places deciding what a cursor means. The host calls it; the plan's wording is satisfied and there is still one owner. The session id is generated at load and never persisted as a stable identity, which is what makes the restart check safe without anybody having to remember to clear anything: a record from a previous run cannot match, so it is ignored. The save happens inside runHostTick and only when the cursor actually moved, so a quiet session does not write to storage once a second. Note what this does not do, and the doc comment says so: sequence numbers restart per process, so this survives a remount and deliberately not a restart - JobStore.recoverInterrupted is the restart-side answer.
